issues.reason: Cardinality states it flatly — a plural with a distributive predicate keeps the group + count + group event and ADDS the per-member rule over (PartOf $x <group>) — and "hunted" is neither a reciprocal/aggregate predicate nor marked "together"/"jointly" (this passage marks "together" exactly where it means collective), so the rule is owed and is missing.

Same rule: "The nightmoths left silken threads" is a definite plural subject with a distributive predicate — the trigger is grammatical number, not whether the referent happens to be a group — so the per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_crowd_1) is due beside the group event and is missing.

Names and casing directs that a multi-word name's kind be stated in one ordinary type atom whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it ("the Kestrel River" -> (Member kestrel_river river)), and "Row" is the kind word inside this name, so (Member east_row row) is licensed and owed rather than optional.

gaps_confirmed: In-world calendar date "day 630 of Year 2": (Day n)/(Year n) presume Gregorian day-of-month and calendar year, so a day-of-year count and a bare regnal year have no specified term

An anaphoric definite whose antecedent was encoded as a bare kind filler ("produced mist-light" … "The mist-light attracted nightmoths"): coreference is specified for a re-mentioned witness, not for a definite pointing at a bare class constant, so the parse mints sk_mistlight_1 and the causal chain is severed

An agent-nominalization's of-phrase ("the keepers of the East Row"): the of-object rule covers act/result/quality nominalizations and the genitive carve-out covers relational nouns "where no underlying verb exists" — a role noun that does have a live verb (keeper/keep) falls between them and nothing selects
new_gaps: A bare indefinite plural understood as a subset of an already-introduced group ("Some nightmoths survived the hunt", after "a crowd of nightmoths") gets no SubsetOf/PartOf link: the partitive machinery keys on explicit "of the / of them" wording, so the survivors group floats free of the crowd it came from
defect_summary: Statement 52 needs, beside the group hunt event, the per-member rule (: skycats_hunt_rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_skycats_1) (And (Member (sk_hunt $x) hunt) (Agent (sk_hunt $x) $x) (Patient (sk_hunt $x) sk_crowd_1) (Past (sk_hunt $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9)). Statement 85 needs the parallel rule over (PartOf $x sk_crowd_1) carrying the leave bundle's class, subject role, threads role, Location and Past into the consequent. Statement 0 needs (: er_type (Member east_row row) (STV 1.0 0.99)) emitted beside the Name atom.
notes: Independently of the filed issues, (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_threads_1) looks like the same object-change misapplication — deposited threads are moved, not altered, so Theme — but it was not filed, so I leave it unadjudicated. The collective/distributive split is otherwise handled as specified ("together" suppresses the rule for lit and produced; gather and shrink stay group-only), which is what makes the two missing rules read as omissions.
